title: Live TV, favorites and the TV guide
items: All live channels and categories, search, favorites and your own lists
TV guide grid with show search, guides from many countries
Cast from the phone to the TV over Wi-Fi
A channel that's off: other feeds of it, then the next channel in the list

title: Preview, sync and sharing
items: Live preview next to channel lists and the guide on TV, tablet and landscape phone
Favorites, lists and settings saved online: back after a reinstall, on every device with your login
Share code for friends (follow or copy), and History of the last 100 versions
Reorder by drag and drop, A–Z sorting, category filter on Live TV

title: Home page and autoplay
items: Home: tiles for Favorites, your lists and pinned categories; Back leads home, then asks before leaving
Autoplay: goes through a list, a channel every minute (Settings → Autoplay); ▶ / ⏸ on the remote
Pinned categories keep their place when the provider renumbers its categories
The channel playing on the TV is underlined while casting

title: Dead channels, reminders and the TV home screen
items: Channels showing a silent “temporarily unavailable” screen are skipped after 5 s
Other feeds of a channel and ⟳ reload, in the player and on the phone remote
Reminders: long-press a show in the guide to be reminded or switched to it
Favorites on the TV home screen, last channel in Continue watching
Player controls hide after 5 s; zapping no longer opens them

title: Hidden categories and What's new
items: Hide categories you never watch: long-press one on Live TV, or Settings → Hidden categories
This “What's new” after an update, and the full list in Settings → App

title: Tidier settings
items: Hidden categories fold away in Settings: tap “N hidden categories” to see them and unhide

title: Keep watching in a small window
items: On the phone and tablet, going to the home screen while watching keeps the channel playing in a small floating window, with ⏮ ⏭, close and full screen
